summary: Mutating templateDriftViolations to return [] unconditionally leaves the entire existing CI green (dotnet test -c Release: 235/235 passed, exit 0) while ./fake.sh -t SelfTest exits 1 with 15 failed cases, so SelfTest is demonstrably the only check that kills the mutant.
evidence: command:python3 edit making 'let templateDriftViolations (root: string) =' return [] unconditionally in a git-archive export of bfd1288, then dotnet test tests/Rogue3.Tests/Rogue3.Tests.fsproj -c Release exits 0 reporting 'Failed: 0, Passed: 235'; command:./fake.sh -t SelfTest on that same mutated tree exits 1 printing 'SelfTest: 30 case(s), 15 failure(s)'; file:.github/workflows/verify.yml
cost: none; this was the acceptance criterion and it now has a measured demonstration rather than an argument
